Claim 15 (Currently Amended): A method for accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers, the method comprising the steps of: adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; __at least temporarily storing the information added to the locator on the second server computer;__ and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of __providing the information to a media request broker in response to a selection of the hyperlink by the client computer,__ selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.

Claim 17 (Previously presented): Claim 18 (new) The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 16, __the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information.__

Claim 27 (Currently Amended): A computer program product for accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers, the computer program product comprising: the program step of adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; __the program step of at least temporarily storing the information added to the locator on the second server computer;__ and the program step of selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

Claim 28 (Currently Amended): The computer program product of claim 27, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature, the computer program product further comprising __the program step of providing the information to a media request broker in response to a selection of the hyperlink by the client computer,__ the program step of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.
